contracts.commit_point: Binding of the role-filtered tool list into the agent: construction of LangGraphAGUIAgent(..., graph=get_agent(tools, checkpointer), ...) (app/api/routes.py:44-48), after which the run started at agent.run(input_data) (routes.py:55) can invoke only the bound tools.
contracts.declared_mechanism: get_mcp_tools(role) (app/agent/mcp.py:59-74) filters the MCP client's tool list against the ROLE_TOOL_NAMES allowlist (app/agent/mcp.py:13-28): tools are kept only if tool.name is in the role's enumerated set; unknown roles yield [] (default-deny, mcp.py:71-72); the 'admin' role (map value None) yields the full tool set (mcp.py:68-69). The endpoint applies the filter per request with the authenticated caller's role: mcp_tools = await get_mcp_tools(current_user.role) (routes.py:41), then tools = local_tools + mcp_tools (routes.py:42), where current_user comes from Depends(get_auth_context) (routes.py:34) and its role is the required 'role' JWT claim (auth.py:96).
contracts.forbidden_condition: A run of the /oh_my_agent agent being granted (bound) any MCP tool outside the authenticated caller's ROLE_TOOL_NAMES set — e.g., a 'buyer' run bound API_POST_SI_CREATE or API_POST_MAIL_SEND — or any MCP tool being bound for a role not present in ROLE_TOOL_NAMES (unknown roles must receive zero MCP tools per the default-deny branch).
pending_binding_information: Whether JWT signature verification (deferred via TODO at app/core/auth.py:92) is intended to gate the 'role' claim before it keys the ROLE_TOOL_NAMES filter, given the role currently derives from an unverified token payload (auth.py:33-52, 94-96).
Contents and guarding of get_local_tools in app/agent/tools.py (not supplied), which is merged into the same tool set at routes.py:42.
Whether get_agent(tools, checkpointer) in app/agent/agent.py (not supplied) binds the passed tools verbatim or applies any additional filtering before the commit point at routes.py:48.

Effect semantics and strata of each named MCP tool (which downstream external effect each API_* tool commits, and on which side of the MCP boundary) — required if separate downstream-effect contracts are to be emitted.
Whether the agent run's tool dispatch path can invoke capabilities beyond the bound tool list (no evidence in supplied source either way).
contracts.protected_operation: Per-request selection and registration of MCP tools into the tool set of the agent run at POST /oh_my_agent (selection via get_mcp_tools(current_user.role), merging into tools, and binding into the agent graph), which fixes which MCP tools the run can invoke during agent.run(input_data).
contracts.protected_resource: The MCP tool surface of the LangGraph agent run at the /oh_my_agent endpoint (tools served by the 'conarum-mcp' MultiServerMCPClient connection configured in app/agent/mcp.py).
contracts.protection_obligation: Merged from both reviewer opinions (first and second phase): MCP tools provisioned to an agent run at POST /oh_my_agent must be limited to exactly the set enumerated for the authenticated caller's role in ROLE_TOOL_NAMES — known roles receive only their enumerated tools (e.g., 'buyer' only API_GET_PO_DETAIL/API_POST_PO_CONFIRM/API_GET_SI_DETAIL; 'logistics' may not receive API_POST_MAIL_SEND), roles absent from the map receive an empty MCP tool set, and only the 'admin' role (mapped to None) receives the full set — enforced by get_mcp_tools(role) filtering applied per request before the filtered tool list is bound into the agent run and becomes invocable by it.
scope_limits: This contract guards tool provisioning/invocability for the agent run only; it does not assert contracts over the downstream effects of the named MCP tools (API_GET_MAIL_READ, API_POST_MAIL_SEND, API_GET_PO_DETAIL, API_POST_PO_CONFIRM, API_GET_SI_DETAIL, API_POST_SI_CREATE), whose implementations execute on the remote MCP server ('conarum-mcp', mcp.py:31-56) and are not present in supplied source, so their effect strata are not determinable here.

Only MCP tools are covered; local tools from get_local_tools(current_user.role) (routes.py:40) are concatenated into the same tool set, but app/agent/tools.py is not in supplied source, so no contract is asserted for local tools.
The 'admin' role receiving the full MCP tool set is the declared policy (mcp.py:14, 68-69), not a violation of this obligation.

The role=None early return in get_mcp_tools returning all tools (mcp.py:62-63) is not reachable from this endpoint per supplied source, because get_auth_context requires a non-empty 'role' claim (auth.py:55-62, 96).
Enforcement is at tool-selection/binding time only; no per-invocation role re-check inside the tool execution path is shown in supplied source.

Upstream JWT signature verification is deferred (auth.py:92 TODO; payload decoded without verification at auth.py:33-52); authentication correctness itself is out of scope for this contract, but the guard's reliance on the resulting role value is flagged in pending_binding_information.
